scripts.refreshRecruitPresentation:
local v = ctx.v
v.onboardingPage = v.onboardingPage or 1

local preview = api.actorPreview(v.candidateActorId, v.candidateLevel or 1)
local actorData = preview and preview.actorData or {}
v.candidatePortraitKey = actorData.portrait or v.portraitKey
v.candidateSpriteKey = actorData.smallBattler or v.portraitKey

v.candidateRoster = {
    {
        name = v.candidateName or "?",
        level = v.candidateLevel or 1,
        hp = v.candidateHp or 0,
        maxHp = v.candidateMaxHp or 1,
        spriteKey = v.candidateSpriteKey,
        portraitKey = v.candidatePortraitKey,
        atk = v.atk or 0,
        def = v.def or 0,
        mat = v.mat or 0,
        mdf = v.mdf or 0,
    }
}

local mpd = v.mpdDelta or 0
if mpd > 0 then
    v.upkeepText = "+" .. tostring(mpd) .. " MP each battle round"
elseif mpd < 0 then
    v.upkeepText = tostring(math.abs(mpd)) .. " less MP each battle round"
else
    v.upkeepText = "No added MP upkeep"
end

local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
local isReserve = slotIdx > 4
local slot = isReserve and (slotIdx - 4) or slotIdx
if isReserve then
    v.reserveCursor = slot
else
    v.lastActiveSlot = slot
end

local occupant = isReserve and api.reserve(slot) or api.party(slot)
if occupant and occupant.empty then occupant = nil end
local rosterName = isReserve and "RESERVE" or "ACTIVE"
v.destinationTitle = rosterName .. " " .. tostring(slot)
    .. " - " .. (occupant and occupant.name or "Empty")

if not occupant then
    v.destinationEffect = isReserve
        and "The candidate joins Reserve."
        or "The candidate joins the Active Party."
elseif not isReserve then
    local emptyReserve = nil
    for reserveSlot = 1, 4 do
        local reserveMember = api.reserve(reserveSlot)
        if not reserveMember or reserveMember.empty then
            emptyReserve = reserveSlot
            break
        end
    end
    if emptyReserve then
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Reserve " .. tostring(emptyReserve) .. "."
    else
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Town Storage."
    end
else
    v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Town Storage."
end

v.confirmText = (v.candidateName or "The candidate") .. " -> " .. v.destinationTitle
    .. "\n" .. v.destinationEffect

    v.onboardingPage = 2
else
    api.recruitment.onSelectRecruitScene(ctx)
end
scripts.navigatePlacementUp:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx > 2 then v.slotIdx = slotIdx - 2 end
else
    local slot = slotIdx - 4
    if slot > 1 then slot = slot - 1 end
    v.reserveCursor = slot
    v.slotIdx = slot + 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementDown:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx <= 2 then v.slotIdx = slotIdx + 2 end
else
    local slot = slotIdx - 4
    if slot < 4 then slot = slot + 1 end
    v.reserveCursor = slot
    v.slotIdx = slot + 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementLeft:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx > 4 then
    v.reserveCursor = slotIdx - 4
    v.slotIdx = v.lastActiveSlot or 2
elseif slotIdx == 2 or slotIdx == 4 then
    v.slotIdx = slotIdx - 1
end
scripts.navigatePlacementRight:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx == 1 or slotIdx == 3 then
        v.slotIdx = slotIdx + 1
    else
        v.lastActiveSlot = slotIdx
        local reserveSlot = v.reserveCursor or 1
        v.slotIdx = reserveSlot + 4
    end
end

scripts.announceLevelUp:

scripts.handleInput:
local v = ctx.v
local b = v.battle
if v.confirmPhase then
    if v.action == "up" or v.action == "left" or v.action == "down" or v.action == "right" then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex % 2) + 1
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif v.action == "select" then if v.selectedIndex == 1 then api.battle.submitRound() else api.battle.undoAction() end end
    return
end
local memberInfo = (v.livingMembers or {})[v.activeMemberIdx or 1]
if not memberInfo then v.combatState = "log" return end
if v.inspectTarget then
    local n = #(v.inspectStateRows or {})
    if v.action == "up" or v.action == "left" then if n > 0 then v.inspectStateIndex = (v.inspectStateIndex - 2) % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" or v.action == "right" then if n > 0 then v.inspectStateIndex = v.inspectStateIndex % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then v.inspectTarget = false end
    return
end
if v.targetSelect then
    local candidates = api.targeting.getCandidates(memberInfo.actor, v.pendingAction.targetSpec, b)
    if v.action == "up" or v.action == "left" then if #candidates > 0 then v.targetIndex = (v.targetIndex - 2) % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" or v.action == "right" then if #candidates > 0 then v.targetIndex = v.targetIndex % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then v.targetSelect = false v.selectedIndex = v.prevSelectedIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" and #candidates > 0 then local chosenTarget = candidates[v.targetIndex] v.targetSelect = false api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, { type = v.pendingAction.type, id = v.pendingAction.id, itemIndex = v.pendingAction.itemIndex, target = chosenTarget }) end
    return
end
if v.skillSelect then
    local options = {}
    for _, skId in ipairs(memberInfo.actor.skills or {}) do local sk = api.getSkill(skId) if sk then table.insert(options, sk) end end
    if v.action == "up" then if #options > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % #options + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" then if #options > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % #options + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then v.skillSelect = false v.selectedIndex = v.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" then local choice = options[v.selectedIndex] if choice then local info = api.skillCost(memberInfo.actor, choice.id) if info.blocked then api.battle.showMessage(choice.name .. ": " .. (info.reason or "Unavailable")) else api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "skill", id = choice.id }) end end end
elseif v.itemSelect then
    local items = api.items()
    if v.action == "up" then if #items > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % #items + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" then if #items > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % #items + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then v.itemSelect = false v.selectedIndex = v.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" then local choice = items[v.selectedIndex] if choice then api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "item", id = choice.id, itemIndex = v.selectedIndex }) end end
else
    local cmds = api.battleCommands(memberInfo.actor) local n = #cmds
    if v.action == "left" or v.action == "up" then if n > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "right" or v.action == "down" then if n > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif v.action == "select" then local cmd = cmds[v.selectedIndex] if cmd then if cmd.resolve == "target" then api.battle.startTargetSelection(cmd.action or { type = cmd.id }) elseif cmd.resolve == "submenu" then v.submenuReturnIndex = v.selectedIndex if cmd.submenu == "skill" then v.skillSelect = true elseif cmd.submenu == "item" then v.itemSelect = true end v.selectedIndex = 1 elseif cmd.resolve == "commit" then local act = { type = cmd.id } if cmd.action then act = { type = cmd.action.type, id = cmd.action.id } if cmd.action.target == "self" then act.target = memberInfo.actor end end api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, act) end end end
end
scripts.handleLogInput:
local v = ctx.v
if v.action == "select" then
    if api.battle.isLogRevealing() then api.battle.finishLogReveal() v.hookHandled = true
    elseif api.battle.isAnimationPlaying() then v.hookHandled = true
    elseif v.eventQueueIndex <= #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then api.battle.advanceLog() if v.pendingRewardLog and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then v.pendingRewardLog = nil v.combatState = "victory" v.victoryStage = 1 elseif v.pendingLevelUpLog and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then v.pendingLevelUpLog = nil v.combatState = "levelup" end v.hookHandled = true
    else v.hookHandled = false end
else v.hookHandled = false end
scripts.handleTransition:
local v = ctx.v
if v.action ~= "select" or not v.battle then v.hookHandled = false return end
if v.combatState == "log" and v.pendingRewardLog and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then v.pendingRewardLog = nil v.combatState = "victory" v.victoryStage = 1 v.hookHandled = true return end
if v.combatState == "victory" and v.rewardPresentationStage == "spoils" then if v.victoryStage == 0 then v.victoryStage = 1 elseif v.victoryStage == 2 then v.rewardPresentationStage = "exp" v.victoryStage = 0 v.eventsQueue = v.eventsQueue or {} v.eventQueueIndex = #v.eventsQueue + 1 local reward = v.victory or {} table.insert(v.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Earned " .. tostring(reward.exp or 0) .. " Experience Points." }) v.pendingRewardLog = "exp" v.combatState = "log" api.battle.advanceLog() end v.hookHandled = true return end
local before = v.combatState v.hookHandled = api.battle.handleTransition(v.action)
if before == "log" and v.combatState == "victory" and not v.rewardAnnounced then v.rewardAnnounced = true v.rewardPresentationStage = "spoils" v.victoryStage = 0 v.eventsQueue = v.eventsQueue or {} v.eventQueueIndex = #v.eventsQueue + 1 local reward = v.victory or {} table.insert(v.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Found " .. tostring(reward.gold or 0) .. " Gold." }) v.pendingRewardLog = "spoils" v.combatState = "log" api.battle.advanceLog() v.hookHandled = true end
scripts.refreshConsole:
local v = ctx.v
local memberInfo = (v.livingMembers or {})[v.activeMemberIdx or 1]
local monster = memberInfo and memberInfo.actor
local rows, helps = {}, {}
if v.inspectTarget then v.commandRows = rows v.currentHelpText = "UP/DOWN: inspect states   PAGE or ESC: return to target" return
elseif v.targetSelect then v.commandRows = rows v.currentHelpText = "PAGE: inspect target   ENTER: choose target   ESC: back" return
elseif v.confirmPhase then table.insert(rows, { name = "Execute Round" }) table.insert(rows, { name = "Back" }) helps[1] = "Execute all queued party actions for this round." helps[2] = "Go back to modify queued actions."
elseif v.skillSelect then for _, skId in ipairs((monster and monster.skills) or {}) do local sk = api.getSkill(skId) if sk then local info = api.skillCost(monster, skId) table.insert(rows, { name = sk.name, icon = sk.icon or 0, costSegments = info.cost, disabled = info.blocked }) table.insert(helps, info.blocked and ((info.reason or "Unavailable") .. " -- " .. (sk.description or "")) or (sk.description or "")) end end if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No skills)" }) end
elseif v.itemSelect then local pending = {} for _, mInfo in ipairs(v.livingMembers or {}) do local act = v.pendingActions and v.pendingActions[mInfo.index] if act and act.type == "item" and (act.id or act.itemId) then local itemId = act.id or act.itemId pending[itemId] = (pending[itemId] or 0) + 1 end end for _, it in ipairs(api.items()) do local full = api.getItem(it.id) local queuedCount = pending[it.id] or 0 local availQty = math.max(0, it.qty - queuedCount) local label = (it.name or "?") .. " x" .. tostring(availQty) if queuedCount > 0 then label = label .. " [" .. queuedCount .. " pending]" end table.insert(rows, { name = label, icon = (full and full.icon) or it.icon or 0 }) table.insert(helps, (full and full.description) or "") end if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No items)" }) end
else v.commandIds = {} for i, cmd in ipairs(api.battleCommands(monster)) do table.insert(rows, { name = cmd.label or cmd.id }) helps[i] = cmd.help or "" v.commandIds[i] = cmd.id end end
v.commandRows = rows v.currentHelpText = helps[v.selectedIndex] or ""
scripts.toggleInspection:
local v = ctx.v
if not v.targetSelect or not v.battle then return end
if v.inspectTarget then v.inspectTarget = false return end
local memberInfo = (v.livingMembers or {})[v.activeMemberIdx or 1]
if not memberInfo or not v.pendingAction then return end
local candidates = api.targeting.getCandidates(memberInfo.actor, v.pendingAction.targetSpec, v.battle)
local target = candidates[v.targetIndex or 1]
if not target then return end
local session = v.battle.session
local loader = session and session.loader
if not loader then return end
local function percent(rate) return math.floor((math.abs(rate or 0) * 100) + 0.5) end
local function traitText(t)
 if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
 local code = t.code
 if code == "PARAM_RATE" then return string.upper(t.param or "stat") .. " x" .. string.format("%.2f", tonumber(t.rate) or 1)
 elseif code == "HRG" then local rate = tonumber(t.rate) or 0 if rate < 0 then return "Loses " .. percent(rate) .. "% Max HP at round end." elseif rate > 0 then return "Recovers " .. percent(rate) .. "% Max HP at round end." end
 elseif code == "HIT" then return "Hit chance " .. (tonumber(t.rate) and ("x" .. string.format("%.2f", t.rate)) or "modified") .. "."
 elseif code == "CRIT" then return "Critical rate " .. (tonumber(t.rate) and ("+" .. percent(t.rate) .. "%") or "modified") .. "."
 elseif code == "CRIT_MULT" then return "Critical damage x" .. string.format("%.2f", tonumber(t.rate) or 1) .. "."
 elseif code == "STATE_RESIST" then local st = loader.getState and loader.getState(t.dataId) return "State resistance: " .. ((st and st.name) or tostring(t.dataId or "?")) .. " x" .. string.format("%.2f", tonumber(t.rate) or 1) .. "."
 elseif code == "ELEMENT_RESIST" then local el = loader.getElement and loader.getElement(t.dataId) return "Element resistance: " .. ((el and el.name) or tostring(t.dataId or "?")) .. " x" .. string.format("%.2f", tonumber(t.rate) or 1) .. "."
 elseif code == "DAMAGE_RATE" then return "Damage taken x" .. string.format("%.2f", tonumber(t.rate) or 1) .. "."
 elseif code == "FORCE_ACTION" then local sk = loader.getSkill and loader.getSkill(t.dataId) return "Forced action: " .. ((sk and sk.name) or tostring(t.dataId or "?")) .. "."
 elseif code == "INVERT_TARGETING" then return "Targeting is inverted."
 elseif code == "INVULNERABLE" then return "Cannot take damage."
 elseif code == "LEECH" then return "Recovers " .. percent(t.rate) .. "% of damage dealt as HP."
 elseif code == "ATTACK_STATE" then local st = loader.getState and loader.getState(t.dataId) return "Attacks can inflict " .. ((st and st.name) or tostring(t.dataId or "?")) .. "."
 elseif code == "ATTACK_ELEMENT" then local el = loader.getElement and loader.getElement(t.dataId) return "Attacks use " .. ((el and el.name) or tostring(t.dataId or "?")) .. "." end
 return nil
end
local function semanticText(def)
 local parts = {}
 if def and def.restriction then local r = tostring(def.restriction) if r == "cannotMove" or r == "cannotAct" then table.insert(parts, "Cannot act.") else table.insert(parts, "Restriction: " .. r .. ".") end end
 for _, t in ipairs((def and def.traits) or {}) do local text = traitText(t) if text and text ~= "" then table.insert(parts, text) end end
 if #parts == 0 and def and def.note and def.note ~= "" then table.insert(parts, def.note) end
 return table.concat(parts, " " )
end
v.inspectName = target.name or (target.actorData and target.actorData.name) or "?"
v.inspectHp = target.hp or 0
v.inspectMaxHp = target.getMaxHp and target:getMaxHp(session) or (target.maxHp or v.inspectHp)
local elementNames = {}
for _, id in ipairs((target.actorData and target.actorData.elements) or target.elements or {}) do local def = loader.getElement and loader.getElement(id) table.insert(elementNames, (def and def.name) or tostring(id)) end
v.inspectElementsText = (#elementNames > 0) and table.concat(elementNames, " / " ) or "None"
local grouped, order = {}, {}
for _, current in ipairs(target.states or {}) do local id = current.id if id then local g = grouped[id] if not g then g = { id = id, count = 0, durations = {}, sources = {} } grouped[id] = g table.insert(order, id) end g.count = g.count + math.max(1, tonumber(current.stacks or current.count) or 1) if current.duration and current.duration ~= 9999 then g.durations[tostring(current.duration)] = true end local source = current.sourceName or current.source if source then g.sources[tostring(source)] = true end end end
local stateRows = {}
for _, id in ipairs(order) do local g = grouped[id] local def = loader.getState and loader.getState(id) or nil local durations = {} for d in pairs(g.durations) do table.insert(durations, tonumber(d) or d) end table.sort(durations, function(a, b) return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b) end) local sources = {} for s in pairs(g.sources) do table.insert(sources, s) end table.sort(sources) local durationText = "" if #durations == 1 then durationText = "Duration: " .. tostring(durations[1]) .. " round" .. (durations[1] == 1 and "" or "s") elseif #durations > 1 then local ds = {} for _, d in ipairs(durations) do table.insert(ds, tostring(d)) end durationText = "Durations: " .. table.concat(ds, ", " ) .. " rounds" end local sourceText = (#sources > 0) and ("Source: " .. table.concat(sources, ", " )) or "" table.insert(stateRows, { name = ((def and def.name) or tostring(id)) .. (g.count > 1 and (" x" .. tostring(g.count)) or ""), icon = (def and def.icon) or 0, count = g.count, description = semanticText(def), durationText = durationText, sourceText = sourceText }) end
if #stateRows == 0 then table.insert(stateRows, { name = "(No active states)", icon = 0, count = 0, description = "No active combat states.", durationText = "", sourceText = "" }) end
v.inspectStateRows = stateRows v.inspectStateIndex = 1
local passiveLines = {}
for _, id in ipairs(target.passives or (target.actorData and target.actorData.passives) or {}) do local def = loader.getPassive and loader.getPassive(id) if def then local details = {} for _, t in ipairs(def.traits or {}) do local text = traitText(t) if text then table.insert(details, text) end end local detail = #details > 0 and table.concat(details, " " ) or (def.description or "") table.insert(passiveLines, (def.name or tostring(id)) .. (detail ~= "" and (": " .. detail) or "")) end end
for _, t in ipairs((target.actorData and target.actorData.traits) or {}) do local text = traitText(t) if text then table.insert(passiveLines, text) end end
v.inspectPassiveText = (#passiveLines > 0) and table.concat(passiveLines, "\n" ) or "None"
local resourceLines = {}
for _, skillId in ipairs(target.skills or {}) do local sk = loader.getSkill and loader.getSkill(skillId) if sk then local detail = {} local timers = target.skillTimers or {} local cooldown = timers.cooldown and timers.cooldown[skillId] or 0 local warmup = timers.warmup and timers.warmup[skillId] or 0 if cooldown and cooldown > 0 then table.insert(detail, "Cooldown " .. tostring(cooldown)) end if warmup and warmup > 0 then table.insert(detail, "Warmup " .. tostring(warmup)) end local current = target.charges and target.charges[skillId] if current ~= nil then if type(sk.charges) == "number" then table.insert(detail, "Charges " .. tostring(current) .. "/" .. tostring(math.max(0, math.floor(sk.charges)))) else table.insert(detail, "Charges " .. tostring(current)) end end if #detail > 0 then table.insert(resourceLines, (sk.name or tostring(skillId)) .. ": " .. table.concat(detail, "  ")) end end end
v.inspectResourceText = (#resourceLines > 0) and table.concat(resourceLines, "\n" ) or "None"
v.inspectTarget = true
